product.name: Acer 65W Charger
product.full_name: Replacement 65W Charger for Acer Aspire / TravelMate
product.description: Replacement power adapter (Model PA-1650-86, Part No. PA-1650-50, PA-1650-69, PA-1650-02) for Acer Aspire 3 (A314-21, A315-21/31/33/41/51/52/53/56), Aspire 5 (A515-43, A515-51/52), Aspire E1/E3/E5/E11/E14/E15/E17 Series, Aspire ES1 Series, Aspire V3/V5/V7/VN7 Series, TravelMate P645/4061-4064/C200-C204, and Ferrari/Extensa/Gateway models using the same connector. 19V, 3.42A, 65W output through the 5.5mm x 1.7mm barrel connector (also backward-compatible with 45W and 40W devices). Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Not compatible with newer Acer models using a 3.0mm port or USB-C only charging (e.g. Aspire 5 A515-56 onward). Tested before dispatch, drop-in replacement for the original charger.

faqs.question: How do I know this charger fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows the wattage and connector type. If you're unsure, send us a photo of your original charger or your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is a higher-wattage charger safe to use?
faqs.answer: Yes — a charger rated higher than your laptop's original wattage is safe; your laptop only draws what it needs. A lower-wattage charger should be avoided.
